page0.text:
I leave the church.
Saber appears as soon as I exit, as if she'd been waiting in the shadows.

page1.text:
"Have you finished your inquiry, Shirou?"
"Yeah. I heard what kind of Master my old man was and about his connection to the Einzberns. The priest also warned me about what I should do next. He's a lot more chatty than he looks.
I feel like I owe him now."

page2.text:
"Huh... The priest was...cooperative?"
Saber blinks a few times in bewilderment.

page3.text:
...
"Sh-Shirou? Are you all right? Did he exact some price from you? Why didn't you call for help if you were in danger, like I said to!?"

page4.text: I must have been making an odd expression, because Saber gets in my face and starts examining me.

page5.text:
...
"What did he do to you, Shirou!? Your wounds aren't fully healed yet. You know what will happen if you're reckless enough to repeat what happened last night!"
Saber gets even closer.

page6.text:
...
"Show me your injuries, Shirou. It's partly my fault you were hurt. I cannot let you die without repaying that debt. I still haven't helped you even once as a Servant. I refuse to let our contract end this way!"

page7.text:
Saber reaches for my shirt, as if to tear it off.
But rather than coming off as frightening, she's...

page8.text:
"Pft."
Oops. I couldn't hold the laughter in.
"...Shirou?"
Saber's hand stops.
Her look of worry becomes a glare, as she realizes what I'm thinking.

page9.text:
"Shirou. It's poor taste to laugh at someone else's discomfort."
"...Heh."
Even her indignation is amusing, and my cheeks start burning.

page10.text:
"Shirou!"
"Aha...ah, sorry. You looked so anxious it surprised me. It's just a happy accident. A dumb mistake of mine."

page11.text: "...A happy accident? I expect you to explain."

page12.text:
Saber looks increasingly offended.
She'd be right at home on the disciplinary committee at school.
I know she's sincerely giving me the what for, but it was so sincere that I got a glimpse beneath her usual veneer.

page13.text: "Why are you grinning...!? Do you find my misunderstanding that amusing!?"

page14.text:
"Sorry. I'm happy to hear it, honest. You seem more upbeat than usual."
"I believe my condition is entirely normal, though. What of it?"

page15.text:
"That's not what I meant. It's like...I saw who you really are for the first time. I'm glad you're an actual girl."
"Wha..."
Saber flinches and takes a step back.

page16.text:
"W-what are you talking about? A Servant's gender is immaterial. We exist only to defeat enemies. It is troubling that you would be pleased by such a fact."
I'm not sure if Saber is angry or exasperated, but she's giving me a withering look.

page17.text:
...
Strangely, it doesn't bother me, and I just keep grinning.

page18.text:
Though she's a Servant, beneath it all, she's still also human.
I don't know what the others are like, but she's the one I'm contracted with. She isn't just a familiar for fighting my battles.

page19.text:
She just said that she hasn't helped me yet.
I recall how she saved me from Lancer, and how she tried to buy me time to get away from Berserker.
She's saved my life twice over, and she still thinks she hasn't helped me.

page20.text:
"I can't tell if you're a busybody or a perfectionist."
"W-why are you looking at me like that? You may be my Master, but I won't tolerate mockery. Take care what you say next."

page21.text: "Fine, fine. Don't be mad. I'm just saying that I'm glad you're the Servant I made a contract with."

page22.text:
"W-what do you mean? I merely answered your summons.
I did not make a contract with you by choice. Are you not the one who chose me?"

page23.text: "Only by coincidence. It's too bad. I wish I could've reached out to you like I meant it."

page24.text:
I extend my right hand to her.
It's something I still haven't done yet.
I have to make her a promise that I should have done from the beginning.

page25.text:
"Shirou...?"
"I know it's overdue, but this is the only way I know how to do it."
Saber wordlessly walks over to me and grasps my hand without hesitation.
Her fingers are thin.
I feel the firm touch of someone other than myself.

page26.text:
"Will you fight with me? I need your help, Saber."
"My oath has not changed. I was summoned to be your sword."

page27.text:
"...And I will require your aid, as well.
I will borrow your power to obtain the Holy Grail. If you trust me, then I will show you power worthy of that faith."

page28.text:
Through her handshake, I feel her warmth.
...
Whatever unease I've harbored is erased without a trace.
It's been half a day since the night when this all started.
For the first time, I finally feel like I have a true ally at my side.
